landing.seoTitle: DYP — Pathwise CC | Transfer planning for California community college students
landing.seoDescription: DYP helps California community college students strive, succeed, and transfer. Track courses, find scholarships, build your transfer pathway, and land internships — all AI-powered.
landing.heroSubtitle: DYP helps community college students strive, succeed, and transfer — track your courses, find scholarships, build your transfer pathway, and land internships. All AI-powered, all in one place.
landing.heroNote: // Free · Replit Auth · No Credit Card
landing.ctaBody: Free for all California community college students. Sign in to begin.
landing.step1Desc: GPA, major, career goal, financial situation, your specific community college.
landing.step2Desc: AI surfaces EOPS, honors, equity cohorts, tutoring centers, and major clubs at your own college.
landing.step3Desc: Personalized list of federal, state, and nonprofit internships verified for CC student eligibility.
landing.step4Desc: Claude AI creates 3 reports with UC/CSU compatibility scores and semester action plans.
landing.step5Desc: Log milestones, get AI feedback, build a complete transfer readiness timeline.
landing.disclaimerBody: DYP is an AI-powered planning tool, not an official academic advisor. All recommendations, GPA targets, and program info are AI-generated estimates. Always verify with your community college counselor and each institution's official resources.
landing.footerLine2: Not affiliated with UC, CSU, or any California institution. Data shown is AI-generated. Verify all information with official sources.
landing.featureCcProgramsDesc: EOPS, Phi Theta Kappa, Umoja, Puente, MESA, TRIO, Transfer Center, and 20+ programs at YOUR community college.
landing.featurePathwaysDesc: Claude AI generates 3 personalized transfer reports — stretch, match, safety — with GPA targets and deadlines.
landing.featureInternshipsDesc: AI-matched internships from DOE, NASA, NIH, CA state agencies, and nonprofits — verified for CC students.
landing.featureScholarshipsDesc: Cal Grants, Jack Kent Cooke, Dream.US, EOPS scholarships, community foundation awards. Live deadline checks.
landing.featureProgressDesc: Log GPA milestones, certifications, leadership roles. Get instant AI feedback on transfer readiness.
landing.featureLikelihoodDesc: AI scores your fit with 25+ UC/CSU/private California universities. Personalized acceptance reports.
landing.featureCoursesDesc: Log completed and in-progress courses. Track GPA, identify articulation gaps, see what's left for transfer.
landing.featureRoadmapDesc: AI semester-by-semester plan with ASSIST.org articulation, transfer deadlines, impacted-major advice.
landing.featureGuidebookDesc: Complete AI guidebook with application timelines, essay tips, financial aid strategy, scholarship checklist.
